Tracciamento degli Incidenti

The systematic process of recording, updating, and monitoring security incidents throughout their lifecycle to ensure accountability, compliance, and timely resolution.

Questions and answers

What is Tracciamento degli Incidenti?

In this glossary, Tracciamento degli Incidenti refers to: The systematic process of recording, updating, and monitoring security incidents throughout their lifecycle to ensure accountability, compliance, and timely resolution.

How is Tracciamento degli Incidenti used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Il tracciamento degli incidenti assicura che tutti i dettagli e le azioni per ogni evento di sicurezza siano registrati e visibili per la revisione post-incidente e le verifiche di conformità."

Definition

The systematic process of recording, updating, and monitoring security incidents throughout their lifecycle to ensure accountability, compliance, and timely resolution.

Operational example

Incident tracking ensures all details and actions for each security event are logged and visible for post-incident review and compliance audits.
